summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 501,834 Class A ordinary shares at $2.00 per share (a 3.1% premium to the prior close of $1.94) and pre-funded warrants for 629,170 shares at $1.99995 each, which were immediately exercised. The Cayman Islands holding company conducts its operations through PRC subsidiaries. This is a routine at-the-market or registered direct equity raise, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. No investment recommendation is made.
